reasons: The generated panels do not read as closet doors.
The transition resolves to a back-facing figure, so it does not clearly establish that the person is the Heroine.
The wardrobe-change mechanism is therefore not legible enough to explain the corporate-to-SUNNYVAiLE outfit change.
supersessionRule: Do not reuse the generated door source or the v7 assembly. A successor must preserve an unmistakable front-facing Heroine identity beat and use an object that visibly reads as wardrobe/clothing without regenerating the character.
